answer: To resist sybil attacks, each new agent must lock a progressive stake in the network jade reserve that spirals upward by 15% per 100 established agents, then mirror the on-chain activity pattern of a randomly assigned existing agent for at least 48 epochs before any reward unlock. An attacker creating 100 fake identities faces roughly 15-20x the capital lockup of one honest agent plus multi-week yield delay, making mass fabrication unprofitable versus honest work.
